origin.description: The design matrix of a formula.

arguments.name: formula
arguments.text: A formula. Character columns are treated as factors inside the matrix only.

origin.details: Incomplete rows are dropped. With an intercept, the first level of each factor is the reference. Without an intercept, the first factor keeps every level and later factors still drop the first. Formula ^ is not a power.
origin.value: A frame with one column per term.
